annotations.title: Lookup Protocol or Token by Name

description: look up a DeFi protocol, token or contract by name, symbol, slug or 0x address (Aave, Ethena, USDe, Moonwell, kUSD): Pacta's verified record with canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (Base-EAS-attested vs RPC-observed only), and ready-to-use preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. Start here when you have only a name, symbol or slug: it returns the chain and address for the next call. 324 protocols + 18 briefs, answered in memory; a 0x address Pacta does not index is answered inline with a who_controls read (the who_controls tool). Free in every pricing mode (an inline who_controls read uses 1 of its 100 free daily calls).

query.description: Protocol or token name, symbol, slug or 0x address (e.g. 'Aave', 'Ethena', 'USDe', 'Moonwell', 'kUSD'). Empty or '*' lists what Pacta tracks.
